say:1:1230124001:1.text: Well, the Carmine Whispers are in charge here.
say:1:1230124001:1.source_cn: 哦，当然，锈锚港有血薇帮。

say:2:1230124002:1.text: But they aren't perfect either. The go door to door hunting down the Water Wights, putting everyone in fear.
say:2:1230124002:1.source_cn: 不过他们也算不上多好，整天挨家挨户地抓水鬼帮的人，大家...

say:3:1230124003:1.text: We can put up with gang conflicts, but not when our business is disrupted!
say:3:1230124003:1.source_cn: 帮派斗争我们也就忍了，可打扰人做生意，这就忍不了了！

say:4:1230124004:1.text: Anyway, I'm just complaining... Even if I wanted to change things, I wouldn't know how to go about it. Maybe there's someone who can.
say:4:1230124004:1.source_cn: 不过，我也就说说……真要让我做什么改变现状，我也做不出...
